title: Mist scan-run envelope
$comment: The contract EPIC-04 (public dashboard) and EPIC-06 (the Mist Index) consume. Owned by EPIC-03. Raw scanner output is ALSO archived unmodified as a CI artifact; this is the normalized join layer, not a replacement for the evidence. Three fields deserve their rationale up front: `party` carries Mist's first/second-party split, which is the whole differentiation from Juice Shop; `counterInvariant` joins back to docs/ANTI_KERNEL.md CI-1..CI-6; `status` distinguishes a scanner that ran and found nothing from one that never ran -- without it a green dashboard cannot be told from an absent instrument. Validated by the deliberately small subset validator in scripts/lib/json-schema-subset.mjs, so it uses only keywords that validator enforces.

schemaVersion.description: Bump only for a breaking change. EPIC-04 and EPIC-06 branch on this.

commit.description: Full sha of the tree scanned. Short shas are not accepted: EPIC-07 rescans a frozen tree and must be able to cite it unambiguously.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601, UTC, Z-suffixed. EPIC-07 charts on this axis.

surface.$comment: The exposure, counted. Every field is nullable and null means NOT MEASURED -- not zero. Before EPIC-02 lands there is no dependency tree, and reporting 0 transitive packages would be a false green: the single most damaging thing this envelope could say. EPIC-06 must treat null as absent data, never as a zero.

packagesWithInstallScripts.description: Evidences CI-1 (hidden input channels). Install scripts are remote code execution you scheduled yourself.

distinctMaintainers.description: Evidences CI-3 (the boundary is node_modules). The count of parties to the trust relationship.

id.$comment: The seven scanner classes named at docs/mist-concept-evaluation.md:53-60. Adding an eighth is a deliberate act and must be argued in docs/SCANNERS.md, not slipped in.

status.$comment: ran = produced parseable output. skipped = did not run, and `skipReason` says why (before EPIC-02 there is no tree for five of the seven). crashed = ran and produced nothing usable; `exitCode` is recorded and findings is empty. A crashed scanner is NOT a clean scanner.

skipReason.description: Required in prose, not in schema, when status is skipped. scripts/check-scan.mjs enforces it -- the subset validator has no conditional keywords and pretending otherwise would be worse than an explicit checker.

version.description: The tool version, verbatim. null only when the tool never ran. EPIC-07 compares runs across months; an unversioned finding is not comparable.

unmapped.$comment: Finding types this scanner emitted that have no clean CI-1..CI-6 mapping, listed EXPLICITLY. EPIC-03 Test Plan scan-ci-mapping-complete forbids silent nulls and permits deliberate ones. The proportion of unmapped types is itself worth watching.

party.$comment: first = Mist's own code. second = something in node_modules. This split is Mist's core differentiation from Juice Shop, whose flaws are first-party and curated while Mist's are second-party and emergent (docs/mist-concept-evaluation.md:68). If the envelope cannot express it, the dashboard cannot make the argument.

subject.description: package@version for second-party, path:line for first-party.

counterInvariant.$comment: Join key to docs/ANTI_KERNEL.md. null is honest when no row fits; the scanner must then list the finding type in `unmapped`.
